Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • scanear (Portugal)

Etymology

[edit]

From escâner +‎ -ear.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /is.ka.neˈa(ʁ)/ [is.ka.neˈa(h)], /es.ka.neˈa(ʁ)/ [es.ka.neˈa(h)], /is.ka.niˈa(ʁ)/ [is.ka.nɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /is.kaˈnja(ʁ)/ [is.kaˈnja(h)], /es.ka.niˈa(ʁ)/ [es.ka.nɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /es.kaˈnja(ʁ)/ [es.kaˈnja(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /is.ka.neˈa(ʁ)/ [is.ka.neˈa(h)], /es.ka.neˈa(ʁ)/ [es.ka.neˈa(h)], /is.ka.niˈa(ʁ)/ [is.ka.nɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /is.kaˈnja(ʁ)/ [is.kaˈnja(h)], /es.ka.niˈa(ʁ)/ [es.ka.nɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /es.kaˈnja(ʁ)/ [es.kaˈnja(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /is.ka.neˈa(ɾ)/, /es.ka.neˈa(ɾ)/, /is.ka.niˈa(ɾ)/ [is.ka.nɪˈa(ɾ)], (faster pronunciation) /is.kaˈnja(ɾ)/, /es.ka.niˈa(ɾ)/ [es.ka.nɪˈa(ɾ)], (faster pronunciation) /es.kaˈnja(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /iʃ.ka.neˈa(ʁ)/ [iʃ.ka.neˈa(χ)], /eʃ.ka.neˈa(ʁ)/ [eʃ.ka.neˈa(χ)], /iʃ.ka.niˈa(ʁ)/ [iʃ.ka.nɪˈa(χ)], (faster pronunciation) /iʃ.kaˈnja(ʁ)/ [iʃ.kaˈnja(χ)], /eʃ.ka.niˈa(ʁ)/ [eʃ.ka.nɪˈa(χ)], (faster pronunciation) /eʃ.kaˈnja(ʁ)/ [eʃ.kaˈnja(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /is.ka.neˈa(ɻ)/, /es.ka.neˈa(ɻ)/, /is.ka.niˈa(ɻ)/ [is.ka.nɪˈa(ɻ)], (faster pronunciation) /is.kaˈnja(ɻ)/, /es.ka.niˈa(ɻ)/ [es.ka.nɪˈa(ɻ)], (faster pronunciation) /es.kaˈnja(ɻ)/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /es.ka.neˈa(ʁ)/ [es.ka.neˈa(h)]

  • Hyphenation: es‧ca‧ne‧ar

Verb

[edit]

escanear (first-person singular present escaneio, first-person singular preterite escaneei, past participle escaneado) (Brazilian Portuguese spelling)

  1. (transitive) to scan
    Synonym: digitalizar

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From escáner (“scanner”) +‎ -ear.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /eskaneˈaɾ/ [es.ka.neˈaɾ], /skaneˈaɾ/ [ska.neˈaɾ]
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: es‧ca‧ne‧ar

Verb

[edit]

escanear (first-person singular present escaneo, first-person singular preterite escaneé, past participle escaneado)

  1. (transitive) to scan
